newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: World Court elects U.S. judge as president.
newsitem.headline: World Court elects U.S. judge as president.

text.p: The International Court of Justice has elected Judge Stephen Schwebel of the United States as its new president, a court official said on Thursday.

Schwebel replaces Mohammed Bedjaoui of Algeria as president of the court which is the main judicial organ of the United Nations and settles disputes between states in accordance with international law.
The court is made up of 15 judges elected for terms of nine years by the U.N. Security Council and the General Assembly.
Five judges are elected every three years, after which all 15 judges elect a new president by secret ballot for the next three years.
